greenhouse.name: Samsara
greenhouse.no_fill_form: POLICY DEAD END (conduct agreement), not a broken form. Every Samsara req carries a REQUIRED field labelled blandly 'AI Policy for Interviewers' whose hidden description reads: 'Please do not use any AI tools during any part of the interview process... Candidates found to be in violation of this policy may be immediately disqualified.' That is a commitment about the user's own future conduct in interviews -- their call, never a default. Detectable offline via boards-api.greenhouse.io/v1/boards/samsara/jobs/<id>?questions=true -- the label alone does not reveal it, only the description does. Route to human before navigating.

ashby.name: Base Power
ashby.no_fill_form: POLICY DEAD END, not a broken form. Base Power reqs carry a REQUIRED 10-option 'Are you legally authorized to work in the U.S.?' select with no truthful option for an F-1 student before post-completion OPT starts: 7 are present-tense statuses (US citizen / H-1B / TN / E-3 / 'I currently hold OPT' / STEM OPT / CPT), 2 assert sponsorship NOW, and 1 ('not currently authorized') contradicts the frozen authorized_to_work=Yes. Route to human before navigating.

lever.name: Binance
lever.no_fill_form: CITIZENSHIP HARD STOP, not a form problem. Every Binance Lever posting carries a REQUIRED 'What is your nationality?' country dropdown (confirmed live). profile.json deliberately records no citizenship country, so this is unanswerable by design. Postings are also non-US (HK/Taipei/Asia) with a sponsorship question scoped to a non-US location, which the US-specific frozen constants cannot answer. Route to human before navigating rather than paying the fill cost each time.
